Sometimes I have been lucky to be visited by a fantastic doctor. She has always been amazing and was the only reason why I stayed with this practice for so long. But I can’t ask for appointments with her unfortunately.

My last experience was a catastrophe and finally I have decided to apply to another GP.

I spoke with the kind nurse over the phone and told her that I have three minors issues to look at. She booked me an appointment at 9.30 on the morning a few days later. I was assigned dr. S Reiss. I was there at 9.29am and the doctor arrived at 9.42am (I noticed that he didn’t even say good morning to his colleague at the desk). He called me in at 9.46am and insisted that we discussed only one issue out of the three and that I had to book other appointments to discuss the rest of the issues. I managed to ask about two before to  be kicked out of his office at 9.49am. I politely insisted that I have been in there for 2 minutes so I couldn’t understand why I I couldn’t ask for another thing. I told him that I live a bit far now and it was going to be an issue for me to come back the same week. He told me  that he will happily see me again if I’d booked another appointment.
Guess what, I hope I never see him again.
When I complained at the desk, the nurse said: “what? You have been in there 3 minutes! I am so sorry about him”
She knew, apologized about him, saying that he’s a cover  doctor and he’s not there all the times but there was nothing that she could do except to book another appointment for me in 4 days time.
I told her to don’t worry, wished her a good day and stopped in the first coffee shop to apply to another GP.
I am still shocked by the experience.",null,[0,238]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPaG9UMENBEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x88ad4a9fae0fbc46!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICOhoT0CA%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPaG9UMENBEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPaG9UMENBEi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ09ob1QwaUFFEhNDZ3dJNzZhQmxRWVFzSk9veHdNGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ09ob1QwU0ESE0Nnd0k3NmFCbFFZUXNKT294d00iEgkAAAAAAAAAABFGvA-un0qtiCoTQ2d3STc2YUJsUVlRc0pPb3h3TQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj4r5uMn7CTAxVHEmMBHWUSOb4QoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,2]]]],"0ahUKEwj4r5uMn7CTAxVHEmMBHWUSOb4Q0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lTRFk1ZFdoTGRGOWZSV2hCWWtkRGRqUTFlSGw0UkV0U1VYZzNSVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVE5DTkVObWNqSTJSWEV3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURtcGFXZ1Z3EAE",["0x0:0x88ad4a9fae0fbc46",null,1643923590020060,1643923590020060,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107122437984212694671/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Sidney Ford","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLGkT_XPq0mQbqBzeY5B_hBvJFmkaqkBQlcXEKbUwuh0Bgxyw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107122437984212694671?hl=en"],"107122437984212694671",null,7,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["7 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj4r5uMn7CTAxVHEmMBHWUSOb4Q7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"4 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Hopefully open to see patients face to face soon
